# RSIC 2026

> RSIC is a student-run inter-school competition in Pakistan, presented by The City School, Ravi Campus. It runs from Friday 13 to Sunday 15 November 2026 at TCS Ravi, with <!--realm-count:lower-->eleven<!--/realm-count--> competitions called Realms.

Schools register as a delegation of 5 to 7 delegates. A delegation enters 5 to 7 realms: Project Nexus and Gaia's Exchange, which are compulsory, and 3 to 5 more. Entry is open to O Levels (Grade 9) and above. Registrations are open now.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cityrsic.com/): countdown, the <!--realm-count:lower-->eleven<!--/realm-count--> realms and how to enter
- [About](https://cityrsic.com/about): why RSIC exists and the disciplines it covers
- [Realms](https://cityrsic.com/realms): all <!--realm-count:lower-->eleven<!--/realm-count--> realms, with format and team size
- [Register](https://cityrsic.com/register): the delegation form, downloadable forms and common questions
- [Invitation](https://cityrsic.com/invitation): the organisers' invitation, page by page, with a PDF to download
- [Spooky Bonfire](https://cityrsic.com/bonfire): the bonfire on 15 November, 6:00 to 8:00 PM, free for RSIC delegates, PKR 500 for outsiders paid on the spot
- [Experience](https://cityrsic.com/experience): what taking part is like
- [Team](https://cityrsic.com/team): the Founders Council and the Executive Council's letter
- [Code of Conduct](https://cityrsic.com/conduct): the Charter of Discipline
- [Updates](https://cityrsic.com/updates): what has been released and what is coming
- [Media](https://cityrsic.com/media): campaign art

<!--realm:film-->- [The Joker's Act](https://cityrsic.com/realms/jokers-act): Film & Drama<!--/realm:film-->
